title: Layer 5: Wild Signals
title_zh: 第五层：草蛇灰线——意外信号
desc: Grassroots clues — more reliable than headlines
desc_zh: 这些不在头条里，但比任何高级指标都准

mbsItinerary.threshold: More Beijing than DC visits = strategic drift
mbsItinerary.threshold_zh: 去北京多于华盛顿=战略偏移
mbsItinerary.note: MBS declined Evian meeting with France (Jun 12). Trump calls MBS a 'warrior'. Saudi played key role in US-Iran ceasefire MOU (Jun 17). MBS lifted Lebanon ban (Jun 11). Hosted Sudan's Burhan in Jeddah (Apr). No new foreign trip reported. Updated 2026-06-21
mbsItinerary.note_zh: MBS拒绝与法国在埃维昂会晤（6月12日）。特朗普称MBS为'战士'。沙特在美伊停火MOU中发挥关键作用（6月17日）。MBS解除黎巴嫩禁令（6月11日）。吉达接待苏丹布尔汉（4月）。无新外访行程。更新于 2026-06-21

singaporeStance.threshold: Singapore picks a side = every other Asian ally is already doing it
singaporeStance.threshold_zh: 新加坡选边=其他亚洲盟友已经在做了
singaporeStance.note: Both US and Chinese AI firms setting up shop in Singapore as 'Asia's neutral AI hub' (Fortune, Jun 20). 'Washington Is Testing Singapore's Patience' (Foreign Policy, Jun 5). No policy stance shift yet, but neutral AI hub role growing. Quad launches Indo-Pacific monitor plan (May). Updated 2026-06-21
singaporeStance.note_zh: 中美AI企业均在狮城设点，新加坡成为'亚洲中立AI枢纽'（财富，6月20日）。'华盛顿在考验新加坡的耐心'（外交政策，6月5日）。政策立场未变，但中立AI枢纽角色在增长。四方机制启动印太监测计划（5月）。更新于 2026-06-21

adbLoanCurrency.threshold: Meaningful increase (>2%) = multilateral acceptance of RMB
adbLoanCurrency.threshold_zh: 显著增长(>2%)=多边机构对RMB的实质接受
adbLoanCurrency.note: Operational acceptance of RMB at multilateral level — slower but more real than SWIFT data
adbLoanCurrency.note_zh: 多边层面RMB的操作性接受——比SWIFT数据慢但更真实

hkmaInterventions.threshold: Sustained weak-side touches = capital outflow pressure from Asia
hkmaInterventions.threshold_zh: 持续触碰弱方=亚洲资本外流压力
hkmaInterventions.note: HKMA interventions = pressure gauge for capital flows from/to Asia
hkmaInterventions.note_zh: 金管局干预频率=亚洲资本流动的压力计

chinaGoldImportPath.threshold: Route change = settlement system de-dollarization in motion
chinaGoldImportPath.threshold_zh: 路径改变=结算体系去美元化在进行
chinaGoldImportPath.note: China buying gold at record pace. 'Gold's center of gravity has moved East' (GoldSilver). US/Canada plot more gold mines as China leads in production (Industrial Info, Jun 4). No confirmed route change data. EU sanctions compliance may constrain direct Russia purchases. Updated 2026-06-21
chinaGoldImportPath.note_zh: 中国以创纪录速度购金。'黄金重心已东移'。美加规划更多金矿，中国产量领先（6月4日）。无确凿的路线变更数据。欧盟制裁合规可能限制对俄直接采购。更新于 2026-06-21

pewFavorability.value_zh: 美国约49% · 中国约36%（2025年，25国中位数）
pewFavorability.threshold: US declining across allies; China stable-low but improving in Global South
pewFavorability.threshold_zh: 美国在盟友中好感度持续下降；中国稳定偏低但在全球南方改善
pewFavorability.note: Pew surveyed 35 countries in 2024 and 25 in spring 2025. US median favorable fell from 54% to ~49%. China rose from 35% to ~36%.
pewFavorability.note_zh: 皮尤2024年调查35国、2025年春季调查25国。美国好感度中位数从54%降至约49%。中国从35%升至约36%。
